```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
raw <- fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)
cat("Number of features:", length(raw$features), "\n")

first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(first_fire)
first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
```

```{r}
#| include: false
#| cache: true
wildfires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)

fires <- wildfires |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
#| include: false
august_fires <- fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, "\\bAugust\\b"))

nrow(august_fires)

fires |>
  arrange(desc(gis_acres)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000)

top_ten_fires <- big_fires |>
  arrange(desc(gis_acres)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  mutate(
    polygon_lng = map(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(boundary) map_dbl(boundary[[1]], \(coordinate) coordinate[[1]])
    ),
    polygon_lat = map(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(boundary) map_dbl(boundary[[1]], \(coordinate) coordinate[[2]])
    ),
    popup = paste0(
      "<strong>", incident, "</strong><br>",
      "Year: ", fire_year, "<br>",
      "Acres: ", format(round(gis_acres), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
    )
  )

all_lng <- unlist(top_ten_fires$polygon_lng)
all_lat <- unlist(top_ten_fires$polygon_lat)
```

The map shows the boundaries of the ten largest wildfires in the dataset. Click a boundary to see the fire's name, year, and acreage; the view is fitted to show all ten.

```{r}
fire_map <- leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldStreetMap")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_ten_fires))) {
  fire_map <- fire_map |>
    addPolygons(
      lng = top_ten_fires$polygon_lng[[i]],
      lat = top_ten_fires$polygon_lat[[i]],
      popup = top_ten_fires$popup[[i]],
      weight = 1,
      fillOpacity = 0.4
    )
}

fire_map |>
  fitBounds(
    min(all_lng),
    min(all_lat),
    max(all_lng),
    max(all_lat),
    options = list(padding = c(10, 10))
  )
```
